PORTHEON - Ports & Mods
Created and maintained by Marcelo Miyake (XAndromedaXR): https://github.com/XAndromedaXR/PORTHEON
Copyright (C) 2026 Marcelo Miyake (XAndromedaXR). The name PORTHEON, its logo and its interface design are Marcelo
Miyake's. Anyone who copies, modifies or redistributes PORTHEON must keep this notice, the credits and the licenses,
and publish the source code of what they distribute (GNU GPL); a modified version must not be presented as the
original PORTHEON or by its author.

PORTHEON's own code (PORTHEON.exe, games\UFC5\UFC5.exe and games\UFC6\UFC6.exe; source in src\, games\UFC5\src and
games\UFC6\src, in every release) is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later
(LICENSE-GPL-2.0.txt). The ports and engines in games\ keep their own licenses, described below and in their folders
(GPL-2.0, GPL-2.0-or-later, some GPL-2.0-only parts, GPL-3.0 for the UFC 4 cheats). The sources of PORTHEON's builds
of the UFC 1-4 ports, of games\engines\intel-arc and of the UFC 6 engine are still being gathered for publication;
until then they can be asked for through the project page.

The bundled gamecontrollerdb.txt is the SDL community controller database (github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB, zlib license, licenses\SDL_GameControllerDB-LICENSE.txt).

The ports are built on SacredFire / bbport (GNSB, T3CHNOLOG1C) and shadPS4. Each port's own licenses folder
(games\UFC<n>\licenses) lists the libraries it contains and their licenses.

PORTHEON 4.0 also carries:
- games\UFC4\cheats\ufc4-cheats.json: UFC 4 cheats from the GoldHEN Cheat Repository
  (github.com/GoldHEN/GoldHEN_Cheat_Repository), GNU GPL version 3 (LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt):
  stamina by aran (game version 04.02), moved to version 28.00 by PORTHEON.
  games\UFC4\scripts\cheats.py loads them as data into the game when the player turns one on; the
  cheats file is distributed with the UFC 4 port under GPL version 3.
- games\UFC<n>\scripts\cpu_compat.py and games\UFC<n>\tools\legacy_plan_*.py (all four ports): the
  processor compatibility mode for Intel Core 2nd/3rd generation (Sandy/Ivy Bridge), from @deanzx06's
  UFC 3 Sandy Bridge patch v2 (GPL-2.0-only), based on T0ug's bloodborne_pc_Ivy-Bridge and the bloodborne_pc
  ports (deadinside28's bbport, and Supermedo's (Mohammed Albarghouthi) Windows port, two authors and two
  repositories). In the UFC 4 port it sits next to the GPL-3.0 cheats file as a separate
  work, not linked with it.
- the community patches in games\UFC<n>\patches (Lepexa, Antigravity).

PORTHEON 4.0.2 also carries games\UFC5: its launcher UFC5.exe (PORTHEON, GPL-2.0-or-later, source in
games\UFC5\src) and bin\UFC 5.exe, a build of KytyPS5 (github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5, GPL-2.0; parts of the
original Kyty under MIT) from Cozma's cozma-ufc5 fork, commit 927a181b, with roshanarunk's UFC 5 work merged.
Its complete source: https://github.com/Cozmaaa/KytyPS5/tree/cozma-ufc5 (commit
927a181b150e00ba88ba613d2e6d5721d6ccaf5b), plus games\UFC5\src\brand_engine.c and ufc5-engine.rc, which only
give the file the UFC 5 icon and name, the window title "UFC 5" and no console window. Licenses and the written
offer: licenses\LICENSE-GPL-2.0.txt and licenses\UFC5 (ENGINE.txt, Kyty-MIT.txt, FFmpeg, Opus).
PORTHEON 4.0.3 built that engine itself from the same commit with games\UFC5\src\ufc5-motor-amd321.patch
(a driver fault or failure while a pipeline compiles no longer closes the game, the engine's own helper shaders
included, with fixed-constant variants of its texture tiling shaders for AMD drivers; a long player name is shortened).
PORTHEON 4.0.4 carries two builds of the newer commit 84f029fe52077feb7fc85e89ee273d57b2486a24 of the same branch:
bin\UFC 5.exe, Cozma's own build, and bin\UFC 5 AMD.exe, PORTHEON's build with that patch, which UFC5.exe starts on
AMD video cards. Both are renamed the same way; licenses\UFC5\ENGINE.txt has the details.
PORTHEON 4.0.7 carried games\UFC5\bin\novo\UFC 5.exe, the KytyPS5 build made for EA SPORTS UFC 6, for an experimental
"New" video engine; it is no longer in the package.
games\UFC5\bin also carries Aeon SR (Barbatos AWLS, MIT License, licenses\UFC5\AeonSR-LICENSE.txt), unchanged, for
the optional frame generation.
The KytyPS5 engines (UFC 5 and UFC 6) also contain, statically linked, the third-party libraries of the KytyPS5 source
tree, among them Dear ImGui (MIT), Tracy (BSD-3-Clause), cpuinfo (BSD-2-Clause), SPIRV-Tools (Apache-2.0), Zydis (MIT),
Xbyak (BSD-3-Clause), Vulkan Memory Allocator (MIT) and, in UFC 5, zstd (BSD-3-Clause); games\UFC6\bin\libwinpthread-1.dll
is the mingw-w64 winpthreads runtime (MIT). Each keeps its own license, carried in that source tree.

PORTHEON 4.0.3 also carries games\pylibs: capstone 5.0.9 (BSD) and keystone-engine 0.9.2 (Python binding BSD,
engine GPL-2.0), unchanged from their Python wheels, with their licenses in games\pylibs\licenses. The
processor compatibility mode of the UFC 1-4 ports uses them to make the translation plan of a game file that
is not the one its shipped plan was made from (tools\build_cpu_compat.py, @deanzx06's generator, GPL-2.0-only).
keystone's source: games\pylibs\licenses\keystone-SOURCE.txt.

PORTHEON 4.3.3 carries games\engines\port-v30 (the engine of the community package "UFC2-UFC4-PC-Port-v3.0", GPL-2.0,
source in its source folder) and 4.3.6 the same package's UFC 2 online server in games\UFC2\tools (ufc3_server.py and
the ufc2_*.py files, GPL-2.0-or-later, unchanged); games\engines\port-v30\README.txt has the details.
PORTHEON 6.1 carries games\UFC<n>\scripts\savedata_import.py (all four ports): savedata_import.py from
UFC2-UFC4-PC-Port (GPL-2.0-or-later), adapted by PORTHEON (the game's title read from its own param.sfo).
PORTHEON 6.1 does not carry Bloodborne's or inFAMOUS Second Son's PC ports: the player installs them from inside
PORTHEON. Bloodborne: bbport-windows by Supermedo (Mohammed Albarghouthi), github.com/Supermedo/bloodborne_pc,
built on deadinside28's bbport (the earlier Linux port, github.com/deadinside28/bloodborne_pc), GPL-2.0-or-later,
downloaded from its own release page. inFAMOUS Second Son: its native PC port, GPL-2.0-or-later, built on shadPS4
(github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4); its package names neither its author nor its own source address. games\BLOODBORNE and
games\INFAMOUS ship only PORTHEON's own drawings (art\) and a PORTHEON-README.txt with each port's credits and licenses.

Not affiliated with Electronic Arts, the UFC or Sony. No game files are included: each port
needs your own copy of the game.

PORTHEON 4.2 replaces games\UFC5 with games\UFC6: its launcher UFC6.exe (PORTHEON, GPL-2.0-or-later, source in
games\UFC6\src) and bin\UFC 6.exe, the KytyPS5 build made for EA SPORTS UFC 6 (3309ab2, "UFC6-1080p", GPL-2.0; parts of
the original Kyty under MIT; the build by Peepo), renamed and given one changed byte by
games\UFC6\src\brand_engine.c (see licenses\UFC6\ENGINE.txt; the location of that build's source is still pending
there). UFC 5 is no longer in the package.

PORTHEON 4.3 brings games\UFC5 back next to games\UFC6 (both described above). 4.3.1 changes the UFC 5 engines' window
title to "UFC 5 | frame: N, fps: F" and one conditional jump of their video-out status, so the game renders its 1080p
mode below a 4K screen (licenses\UFC5\ENGINE.txt has the offsets and bytes). UFC5.exe and UFC6.exe can copy a
player's own shader caches from games\UFC<n>\cache-inicial; the package ships none, as they hold the game's shaders.

PORTHEON 4.3.2 also carries games\UFC5\bin\PortheonFXAA.dll and VkLayer_PORTHEON_fxaa.json: PORTHEON's own Vulkan
layer (GPL-2.0-or-later, source in games\UFC5\src\fxaa) that UFC5.exe enables for the UFC 5 engine when the player
turns anti-aliasing on. It draws an FXAA pixel shader over each presented frame; that shader is the one compiled into
the UFC 6 engine (KytyPS5 build 3309ab2, GPL-2.0, games\UFC5\src\fxaa\fxaa_fs.inc), so the layer as built is GPL-2.0.

Credits, as the PORTHEON author gives them:
- the UFC 5 engine: the build by Cozmaa and Brotski, improved by XAndromedaXR for PORTHEON;
- the UFC 6 engine: the build by Peepo, improved by XAndromedaXR for PORTHEON;
- the FPS patch: lepexa_cell (Lepexa), improved by XAndromedaXR; the other community patches: Lepexa and Antigravity;
- the UFC 1-4 ports: built on GNS (GNSB)'s UFC 3 PS4 port, SacredFire / bbport (GNSB, T3CHNOLOG1C) and shadPS4;
  the processor compatibility mode: deanzx06, T0ug, deadinside28 and Supermedo (Mohammed Albarghouthi); the UFC 4
  cheats: aran.

PORTHEON is free: its author does not sell copies of it and only accepts donations.
